easyPrerequisites:
You control three additional Islands.
You control three or more lands that share a name.
description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
